title: Playground Window Mode Completeness Pass
description: Bring every playground's windows and modes up to the same completeness bar: every WindowKindRuntime gets populated measures rail and WindowEngagement; every ModeRuntime gets populated tools footer toolbar. Add runtime auditor to enforce.
summary: Brought every playground up to the puzzle/shooting completeness bar: all WindowKindRuntime instances now have populated measures rails and WindowEngagement; all ModeRuntime instances have footer toolbar tools. Added shared generate-mode helpers in flow/play, fixed hostBridge-gated toolbars (shooting, procedural 2d/3d, puzzle 2d), added gis map engagement, and landed a cross-playground vitest audit (`nx run @semio-tech/framework-playground-core:audit`) wired into launch.json.
